messages.text: hey - putting my product principal hat on for a sec, re writing tool: who owns tier-2 support once the vendor's implementation team hands off? i don't want ODS holding it by default

because that's how it always goes. vendor runs a lovely onboarding, leaves, and in october a saltmarren instructor can't get feedback on 40 essays the night before grades are due. who picks up the phone at 2am? right now the answer is "whoever is listed last in the contract", which is us
good q - i'll put it in the requirements. named tier-2 owner after the handoff, not assumed
also any ETA on the kettleyard service catalog entry?
